pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng wūlǐ bānchū nà zhī shúxī de xiǎo tiěhé shí , níng qí hé ruǎn héng hái zài zhēng .
pairs.english: As Tavi brought the familiar little iron box out of the room, Ningqi and Ruan Heng were still arguing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从屋里搬出那只熟悉的小铁盒时，宁岐和阮衡还在争。

pairs.target: búshì chǎojià , liǎnggè rén de shēngyīn dōu bù gāo , què shuí yě méi ràng duìfāng bǎ huà shōuzhù .
pairs.english: It was no shouting match: both kept their voices low, yet neither let the other finish the matter.
pairs.hanzi: 不是吵架，两个人的声音都不高，却谁也没让对方把话收住。

pairs.target: níng qí yào zài jiù zhīzuò páng zài tiān liǎngchù cèdiǎn , ruǎn héng shuō rénshǒu jìdìng , xiānqián dāying de xià tóu tōngxíng jiǎnchá hái méi zuò wán , bùnéng jiāng yù hé zhěnggè rén jiè qù , zàishuō yíjù dōu bù dānwù .
pairs.english: Ningqi wanted two more measuring points beside the old supports. Ruan Heng said staffing was fixed and the promised lower passage inspection unfinished; she could not borrow all of Yuhe and claim there would be no delay.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐要在旧支座旁再添两处测点，阮衡说人手既定，先前答应的下头通行检查还没做完，不能将郁禾整个人借去，再说一句都不耽误。

pairs.target: " wǒ méi shuō bù dānwù . " níng qí jiāng tú fàngzài tā miànqián , " zhèlǐ shǎo yìbiān , hòutou nà fèn bàogào wǒ bùnéng qiān . "
pairs.english: “I didn't say no delay.” Ningqi put the diagram in front of him. “With one side missing here, I can't sign the report afterward.”
pairs.hanzi: “我没说不耽误。”宁岐将图放在他面前，“这里少一边，后头那份报告我不能签。”

pairs.target: " nà jiù xiě shǎo yìbiān . "
pairs.english: “Then write that one side is missing.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就写少一边。”

pairs.target: " xiě le , nǐ kěn ná tā qù gēn cāng xíng shuō , zài děng xià yìlún rén lái ? "
pairs.english: “And will you take that to the warehouse firms and tell them to wait for the next crew?”
pairs.hanzi: “写了，你肯拿它去跟仓行说，再等下一轮人来？”

pairs.target: ruǎn héng kànzhe tā , méiyǒu lìkè dá . tǎ wéi jiāng hézi fàng shàng yuànlǐ de dúlì mù tái , shēngxiǎng yǒudiǎn zhòng , liǎng rén dōu zhuǎnguò tóu , tā zhǐhǎo shuō zìjǐ zhǎodào le .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng looked at her without answering immediately. Tavi set the box on the courtyard's freestanding wooden bench a little too loudly; both turned, and he could only say he had found it.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡看着她，没有立刻答。塔维将盒子放上院里的独立木台，声响有点重，两人都转过头，他只好说自己找到了。

pairs.target: jīnrì yào zuò de shì gěi cè chǐ zhuāng yígè xiǎo kòu , ràng chǐ néng shōu jìn jià lǐ , miǎnde tái shàng zhǎi tī shí dǐng dào ménkuàng .
pairs.english: Today's task was fitting a small clasp to a measuring rule so it would fold into its frame instead of striking doorframes on the narrow stairs.
pairs.hanzi: 今日要做的是给测尺装一个小扣，让尺能收进架里，免得抬上窄梯时顶到门框。

pairs.target: kòujiàn bù jiē jiù hú , zhuāngpèi yòng de réng shì ruǎn héng nà duì xiǎo tiě jiàn hé yuánlái de jiājù , zuòhǎo de xiāo tóu huì zìjǐ liúzhù kòujiàn , búyòng jiè xìng yìzhí chēng zhe .
pairs.english: The clasp did not join the old arch. Assembly used Ruan Heng's same small iron pair and original fixture; the finished pin head would hold the clasp mechanically, without continuous property borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 扣件不接旧弧，装配用的仍是阮衡那对小铁件和原来的夹具，做好的销头会自己留住扣件，不用借性一直撑着。

pairs.target: ā xún yǐjīng jiāng jiàzi chāichéng liǎngduàn , bào zhe jiào cháng de nà yì jié zuòzài pángbiān , shēnshǒu tì tǎ wéi fúzhù zhǐ .
pairs.english: Axun had divided the frame in two and sat beside them holding the longer section, reaching out to steady Tavi's paper.
pairs.hanzi: 阿荀已经将架子拆成两段，抱着较长的那一截坐在旁边，伸手替塔维扶住纸。

pairs.target: tā xiān jiǎnchá mù tái méiyǒu kào dào qiáng lǐ de jiù tiě , zhīdiǎn , dǎng kuài , qīngzǎi dōu tóng ruǎn héng hé guò ;
pairs.english: Tavi first checked the bench was not touching the old iron in the wall, and verified supports, stops and light loads with Ruan Heng.
pairs.hanzi: 他先检查木台没有靠到墙里的旧铁，支点、挡块、轻载都同阮衡核过；

pairs.target: tiě jiàn shì qiánxiētiān nà liǎngjiàn , zhěngjiàn de tǐjī méi biàn , gōubiān yě méiyǒu xīn kē kǒu .
pairs.english: The iron pieces were the same two from days earlier, their whole volumes unchanged and groove edges free of new nicks.
pairs.hanzi: 铁件是前些天那两件，整件的体积没变，沟边也没有新磕口。

pairs.target: yù hé fùzé tuīxiāo , zài zhuōbiān kōng bǐ le yícì , wèn tā shǒu tái kāi hòu , xiāo cóng nǎbiān lái . tā shuō zuǒbiān , tā kàn le kàn zìjǐ zhàn de wèizhì , huàn dào lìngyícè .
pairs.english: Yuhe would push the pin. Trying the movement beside the table, she asked which side the pin should enter after his hands lifted. He said the left; she checked her position and changed sides.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾负责推销，在桌边空比了一次，问他手抬开后，销从哪边来。他说左边，她看了看自己站的位置，换到另一侧。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén dōu xiào le yíxià . ruǎn héng guòlái wèn tā zhǔnbèi hǎo le méiyǒu , tǎ wéi diǎntóu , shuāngshǒu luò shàng jiēchùmiàn .
pairs.english: They both smiled. Ruan Heng came to ask if he was ready; Tavi nodded and placed both hands on the contact surfaces.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人都笑了一下。阮衡过来问他准备好了没有，塔维点头，双手落上接触面。

pairs.target: cái tīngdào níng qí zài shēnhòu shuō cèdiǎn kěbukěyǐ nuó , zhùyì biàn piān guòqù yíshùn . liǎngbiān de xiǎngyìng hái méi duì wěn , tā méiyǒu táishǒu , xiān jiāng nà yìdiǎn qǐtóu de biànhuà jiěkāi .
pairs.english: Hearing Ningqi behind him ask about moving a measuring point, his attention slipped for an instant. The responses were not balanced yet; without lifting his hands, he canceled the small initial change.
pairs.hanzi: 才听到宁岐在身后说测点可不可以挪，注意便偏过去一瞬。两边的响应还没对稳，他没有抬手，先将那一点起头的变化解开。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng wèn zěnme le . tā shuō zìjǐ zài tīng tā jiǎnghuà , bùxiǎng zhuāngzuò yǐjīng wěn le .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng asked what had happened. Tavi said he had been listening to her and did not want to pretend the balance was stable.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡问怎么了。他说自己在听她讲话，不想装作已经稳了。

pairs.target: níng qí tíngzhù , táishǒu shìyì shì zìjǐ de búshì , jiāng tú juǎnqǐ , lǐng ā xún dào yuànzi lìngyìtóu qù le .
pairs.english: Ningqi stopped and raised a hand to acknowledge her fault, rolled up the drawing, and took Axun to the other end of the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐停住，抬手示意是自己的不是，将图卷起，领阿荀到院子另一头去了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hē le shuǐ , shēn zhǐ yòu wòquán , shǒulǐ méiyǒu fāmù , yǎndǐ què xiàng gāng zhuī zhe xìzì kànguò yìháng .
pairs.english: Tavi drank water, stretched his fingers and made a fist. His hands were not numb, but his eyes felt as though they had followed a line of tiny writing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝了水，伸指又握拳，手里没有发木，眼底却像刚追着细字看过一行。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu mǎshàng zài pèng , zuò zhe děng nà gǔ jǐnbēng tuì xià .
pairs.english: He did not touch the pieces again at once, sitting until the tension eased.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有马上再碰，坐着等那股紧绷退下。

pairs.target: yù hé yě zuòxià , ná xiǎo dāoxiāo yì jié yòngzuò tuō diàn de ruǎnmù , xiāo liǎngxià biàn ràng tā kàn , wèn zhèyàng huì buhuì dǎng xiāo .
pairs.english: Yuhe sat too and used a knife to shave softwood for a support pad. After two cuts she showed him, asking whether it would obstruct the pin.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾也坐下，拿小刀削一截用作托垫的软木，削两下便让他看，问这样会不会挡销。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō nà dé wèn tā de shǒu , tā jiāng mùkuài fàng hǎo , láihuí shì le yíbiàn , zìjǐ liúxià yìdiǎn yúdì .
pairs.english: Tavi said she would have to ask her own hands. She positioned the block, tried the movement back and forth, and left a little clearance herself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说那得问她的手，她将木块放好，来回试了一遍，自己留下一点余地。

pairs.target: chóngxīn liáng guò yuánlái de dúshù , ruǎn héng cái ràng tāmen zài lái .
pairs.english: Only after rechecking the baseline did Ruan Heng let them try again.
pairs.hanzi: 重新量过原来的读数，阮衡才让他们再来。

pairs.target: zhè yícì tǎ wéi méiyǒu děng shēnhòu de shēngyīn quán xiāoshī , zhī bǎ zhùyì fàng huí liǎngjiàn wánzhěng de xiǎo tiě shàng .
pairs.english: This time Tavi did not wait for every sound behind him to vanish, only returned his attention to the two whole small iron pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 这一次塔维没有等身后的声音全消失，只把注意放回两件完整的小铁上。

pairs.target: qīngzǎi xià de xìxiàn yìbiān piān , yìbiān shōu , tā mànmàn wěnzhù , tīngjiàn yù hé shuō kěyǐ le , shuāngshǒu cái yìqí táiqǐ .
pairs.english: Under light loads one fine line moved out while the other drew in. He steadied them slowly and lifted both hands together only when Yuhe said she was ready.
pairs.hanzi: 轻载下的细线一边偏，一边收，他慢慢稳住，听见郁禾说可以了，双手才一齐抬起。

pairs.target: xiāo tuījìn qù de shíhòu , dìyīshēng bǎi xiǎng hái méi dào .
pairs.english: The pin went in before the pendulum's first click.
pairs.hanzi: 销推进去的时候，第一声摆响还没到。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuāngshǒu chóngxīn luò huí , jiěkāi , yù hé sōngkāi tuīxiāo de shǒu , kòujiàn réng láoláo liúzài chǐ bèi .
pairs.english: Tavi replaced both hands and canceled. Yuhe released the pin, and the clasp remained firmly on the rule's back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维双手重新落回，解开，郁禾松开推销的手，扣件仍牢牢留在尺背。

pairs.target: xièzài zài cè , dúshù huídào yuánchù , ruǎn héng jiāng jīnrì zuìhòu nà yìxiǎo gé jì wán , jiào tāmen shōu hé .
pairs.english: They unloaded and measured again; readings returned to baseline. Ruan Heng completed the day's last little box and told them to pack up.
pairs.hanzi: 卸载再测，读数回到原处，阮衡将今日最后那一小格记完，叫他们收盒。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng mō yi mō zìjǐ zuòhǎo de dìfāng , ā xún xiān jiāng chǐ ná qǐlái , shì zhe hé jìn jià lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to feel his finished work, but Axun picked up the rule first and tried folding it into the frame.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想摸一摸自己做好的地方，阿荀先将尺拿起来，试着合进架里。

pairs.target: láihuí liǎngcì méi pèngdào ménkuàng , tā zhuǎnshēn wàng xiàng níng qí , xiào zhe shuō zhèhuí zǒng búyòng jǔ zhe tā xiān zǒu bàngè rén .
pairs.english: Twice it passed without hitting the doorframe. Turning to Ningqi, he grinned that now he no longer had to hold it out ahead of him like half an extra person.
pairs.hanzi: 来回两次没碰到门框，他转身望向宁岐，笑着说这回总不用举着它先走半个人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng yǒudiǎn déyì , yù hé biàn jiāng zìjǐ xiāo dé wāiwāi de mù diàn bǎizài yìpáng , wèn tā yào buyào yě dàishàng , liú zuò liǎng rén yìqǐ zuòhuó de píngjù .
pairs.english: Tavi began to feel proud, and Yuhe set her crooked wooden pad beside it, asking whether he wanted that too as evidence of their work together.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚有点得意，郁禾便将自己削得歪歪的木垫摆在一旁，问他要不要也带上，留作两人一起做活的凭据。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , ruǎn héng háishì jiāng duō cè liǎngchù de shì xiě huíhé lù suǒ , yāoqiú quèrèn jiā pài jià gōng de rìzi ;
pairs.english: That afternoon Ruan Heng wrote to the Joint Routes Office about the two extra measuring points, requesting a confirmed date for additional riggers.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，阮衡还是将多测两处的事写回合路所，要求确认加派架工的日子；

pairs.target: níng qí dāying xiān bǎ xià tóu yǐjīng pái hǎo de nàduàn zǒu wán , bù ná tǎ wéi dāng dìèrgè yù hé .
pairs.english: Ningqi agreed to finish the scheduled lower stretch first and not treat Tavi as a second Yuhe.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐答应先把下头已经排好的那段走完，不拿塔维当第二个郁禾。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén de liǎnsè dōu méi quán sōng , kě wǎnfàn shí réng zuò dào yìzhuō , qiǎng zuìhòu bàn dié chǎo dòu .
pairs.english: Neither looked entirely relaxed, yet at supper they shared a table and fought over the last half dish of fried beans.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人的脸色都没全松，可晚饭时仍坐到一桌，抢最后半碟炒豆。

pairs.target: luó dí bàngwǎn lái zhǎo ā xún jiè páozǐ , tīngshuō chǐ bèi de xiǎo kòu zhuāng hǎo le , ná qǐlái fān le fān , shuō ruò zǎo liǎngrì zuò , tā yěxǔ néng ná tā gēn tángxiōng huàn gè hǎo jiàqián .
pairs.english: Luodi came that evening to borrow Axun's plane. Hearing the clasp was fitted, he turned it over and said two days earlier he might have traded it to his cousin for a fine price.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻傍晚来找阿荀借刨子，听说尺背的小扣装好了，拿起来翻了翻，说若早两日做，他也许能拿它跟堂兄换个好价钱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng chǐ cóng tā shǒulǐ chōu huílái , shuō zhè yìhuí shì yù hé tuī de xiāo , jiàqián dé wèn tā .
pairs.english: Tavi pulled the rule back from his hands and said Yuhe had pushed the pin this time, so she should set the price.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将尺从他手里抽回来，说这一回是郁禾推的销，价钱得问她。

pairs.target: yù hé duān zhe wǎn shuō búyào qián , zhǐyào tā míngrì tì zìjǐ qù mǎi huājiāo .
pairs.english: Holding her bowl, Yuhe said she wanted no money, only for him to buy pepper for her tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾端着碗说不要钱，只要他明日替自己去买花椒。

pairs.target: luó dí lìkè wèn mǎi jǐdài , níng qí zài pángbiān shuō , xiān bié dāying , zhè rén yǐjīng wǎng zìjǐ de bāo lǐ sāi le liǎngdài , nándào yào yílù mài huí tóng jiē chéng qù .
pairs.english: Luodi immediately asked how many bags. Ningqi warned him not to agree yet: Yuhe had already stuffed two bags in her pack, did she mean to sell them all the way back to Copperstep City?
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻立刻问买几袋，宁岐在旁边说，先别答应，这人已经往自己的包里塞了两袋，难道要一路卖回铜阶城去。
